commits:
Read/write leaderboard Markdown as UTF-8 so the toolkit works on Windows

LEADERBOARD.md contains non-ASCII (the Pareto check mark and em dashes).
On Windows the default text encoding is cp1252, so:

* `leaderboard-all` crashed with UnicodeEncodeError while writing the file;
* `leaderboard-all --check` and tests/test_leaderboard.py decoded the
  committed UTF-8 file as cp1252 and reported it out of date;
* scripts/verify_submissions.py crashed printing its final check mark,
  exiting 1 even when every solution was legal.

Open the Markdown files with encoding="utf-8" and let the verify script
replace characters the console cannot encode. No behaviour change on
macOS/Linux. Full test suite (43 tests) passes on Windows 11 / Python 3.11.

Merge pull request #13 from IrwinJam/fix/windows-utf8

Fix UTF-8 errors on Windows
